description:
FILED s519b (Opus 5.5, s520, 2026-10-18) from the IO-Compress board census (12 t-files stop at "Can't locate object method "readHeader" via package "IO::Uncompress::AnyInflate"" / AnyUncompress).

SILENT WRONG: re-blessing a COPY of a reference to a GLOB does not reach the original reference -- the class goes on the copy's variable box only.

Minimal reproducer (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL; also wrong on main fd04c048):
  use Symbol;
  my $o = bless Symbol::gensym(), 'A'; my $p = $o; bless $p, 'C'; print ref($o), "\n";   # perl C, PCL A
  my $s = bless \do { local *FH }, 'A'; my $t = $s; bless $t, 'C'; print ref($s), "\n"; # perl C, PCL A
  my $h = bless {}, 'A'; my $i = $h; bless $i, 'C'; print ref($h), "\n";               # perl C, PCL C (hash refs are right)
The IO-Compress shape: IO::Uncompress::AnyInflate::ckMagic does `bless $self => "IO::Uncompress::$_"` in a loop over candidate formats and returns on the first magic; the CALLER (mkUncomp, its own `my $self` copy) then calls `$self->readHeader($magic)` and still sees AnyInflate.  (A re-bless reached through a method's @_ can work by accident: `sub k { my $self = shift; bless $self => "C" } $o->k` prints C -- so the discriminator is a copied scalar, not the call.)

CAUSE (read, not yet fixed): cl/pcl-runtime.lisp `p-bless`'s final `t` arm -- a glob ref is neither a hash target, nor a box target, nor a handle payload (%p-handle-payload-p), so the class is written ONLY to `(p-box-class ref)`, the VARIABLE's box; perl blesses SvRV, the glob.  FIX SHAPE: when the referent is a glob object, record the class against the GLOB (a weak EQ side table like *p-handle-stash* / *p-sv-stash*, or a slot on the glob struct) and have `p-get-class` / `ref` read it before the variable's cache -- the same target-first rule %p-target-class applies to hashes and boxes.  BAR: the three probe lines = perl; IO-Compress's 002any-*.t / 101truncate-*.t / the AnyUncompress files then run past readHeader (one-file `tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows`); a guard row in an existing bless file; companion op/bless.t + uni/bless.t one-file runs; the sweep (cl/).
subject: SILENT WRONG: re-blessing a COPY of a glob ref (Symbol::gensym, \do{local *FH}) does not reach the original -- p-bless writes the class on the variable box only; IO::Uncompress::AnyInflate loses its ckMagic re-bless (12 IO-Compress files)
